settings.name: REDIRECT_HTTP_TO_HTTPS
settings.description: **Redirect HTTP to HTTPS:** When set to `yes`, all HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS.

settings.name: AUTO_REDIRECT_HTTP_TO_HTTPS
settings.description: **Auto Redirect HTTP to HTTPS:** When set to `yes`, automatically redirects HTTP to HTTPS if HTTPS is detected.

settings.name: SSL_PROTOCOLS
settings.description: **SSL Protocols:** Space-separated list of SSL/TLS protocols to support.

settings.name: SSL_CIPHERS_LEVEL
settings.description: **SSL Ciphers Level:** Preset security level for cipher suites (`modern`, `intermediate`, or `old`).

settings.name: SSL_CIPHERS_CUSTOM
settings.description: **Custom SSL Ciphers:** Colon-separated list of cipher suites to use for SSL/TLS connections (overrides level).

settings.name: SSL_ECDH_CURVE
settings.description: **SSL ECDH Curves:** Colon-separated list of ECDH curves (TLS groups) or `auto` for smart selection (prefers PQC on OpenSSL 3.5+).

settings.name: SSL_SESSION_CACHE_SIZE
settings.description: **SSL Session Cache Size:** Size of the SSL session cache (e.g., `10m`, `512k`). Set to `off` or `none` to disable.
